meta.project: Q-Care Detect — Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning Platform for Early Disease Detection

product_overview: Q-Care Detect is a research-oriented platform for comparing classical machine learning and hybrid quantum machine learning on public biomedical benchmark data. It provides tabbed web views for exploring catalogs, benchmark comparisons, and research scoring tools, with clear disclaimers that it is not for clinical use.
core_goals: Help users explore a research-only hybrid quantum machine learning platform for early disease-risk classification.
Allow users to compare classical baseline results with QML benchmark results on public datasets.
Provide access to a public data catalog and saved model summaries for research inspection.
Let users score a single research record from tabular field values and optionally generate a locked research report.
Keep the interface clearly labeled as educational and non-clinical throughout the experience.

features.name: Research disclaimer chrome
features.description: A persistent header and footer keep the product framed as an educational, research-only tool and explicitly state that it is not a medical device.
user_flows: Open the home page -> Read the research-only advisory at the top -> Scroll through the page -> Notice the non-diagnostic disclaimer remains visible in the footer

features.name: Header tab navigation
features.description: The main header lets users switch between the product’s research views such as Story, Data, Classical, QML, Cost, Simulator, and the record-scoring flow.
user_flows: Open the home page -> Choose the Story view -> Switch to the Data view -> Switch to the Cost view -> Switch to the Simulator view -> Observe the active tab highlight change after each selection

features.name: Public data library
features.description: The Data view shows a catalog of public research tables and saved models, with simple search or filtering for browsing available benchmark resources.
user_flows: Open the home page -> Switch to the Data view -> Wait for the catalog cards to appear -> Search or filter the listed tables -> Review the available dataset and model entries

features.name: Cost latency dashboard
features.description: The Cost view summarizes quantum-vs-classical benchmark tradeoffs, including F1 comparison and fit-time messaging for QSVC versus RBF baselines.
user_flows: Open the home page -> Switch to the Cost view -> Read the QSVC and RBF F1 comparison -> Read the latency comparison message -> Observe that QSVC is described as slower rather than more accurate

features.name: Paste a record research score
features.description: The record-scoring flow lets users enter a single table of field values, submit it for a research score, and optionally generate a locked PDF report with identity details.
user_flows: Open the home page -> Open the Paste a record flow from the menu -> Enter a table of field values using the provided numeric ranges -> Submit the table for scoring -> Review the research score result -> Optionally enter a name and date of birth -> Generate the locked PDF report
